nom: TruSkin Vitamin C Super Serum for Face

avis.texte: This picture is after a month of use. I’ve had hyperpigmentation for 10 years now from laying on the sun while on antibiotics when I was in my 20s - not smart. The dark spots are fading and significant lighter. Several of the spots and freckles have completely vanished. Now, for the large hyperpigmentation areas on both cheeks, I hope it continues to fade. Again, this pic is only after a month. Visible results in 1 month is amazing for a product under $30.00. This serum has retinol which can cause dry skin. I use a serum before I apply it and a moisturizing serum and moisturizer after to avoid drying out and flaking. It’s worked - my skin is not dry or flaking and has a glow. Super silky product and feels smooth on skin, it’s refreshing. No smell, and didn’t make my face red. It seems to absorb well, but I use a hairdryer in between each product u use to open my pores with the warm air and dries the product faster and absorbs quicker. It application, just like all serums. Very pleased and I am excited to see more results in a month from now. If you struggle with stubborn skin damage like me (mine is really bad) I know how freaking frustrating it is when you just want it gone! I thought my face would stay this dark and get darker for the rest of my life. I have a little bit of hope now that it will mostly go away one day if I keep following a skin routine. I have never strictly followed a skin care routine. Now I religiously have for a month and I’m already seeing lightening.

I used the TruSkin serum for about two weeks now and, at first, noticed how well my skin was reacting to it by being soft and smooth. These last two days my skin did a complete 180° and started turning red and drying out. I'm thinking I can't use this every day. I'll probably continue to use on an as-needed basis just on dark spots because I thought it was helping with dark spots and my skin was looking pretty good. I really wish I could continue everyday though.

With someone with very sensitive skin, I am truly happy to have found this product. It doesn’t irritate my skin in any way and it is lightweight on the skin. It actually works n does decrease the dark spots and brighten up the skin. It’s fragrance free, lasts long and I will definitely continue to buy this.

So I wanted to add a serum into my routine, just turning 30, my skin took some kind of nose dive and broke out pretty bad. I needed soemthing with all the right things in one bottle. If you're thinking about trying this stuff, do it. Because Erica checks

I love this product. I've been using twice a day for over a year. My skin is so much clearer and the cystic acne is essentially gone. I would have given it 5 stars. But something happened 3 or 4 months (?) ago, or so. I opened the box, took the bottle out and put it on my bathroom counter. A few minutes later, I gave it a quick shake to mix before using it. Serum went everywhere!!! There was an open crack all along the top of the lid. I had thought it had broken in shipment. I shipped it back and Amazin sent me a new one. When it arrived, I inspected the cap closely at it was fine, so I took off the cellophane security tape. The cap immediately split in the same way. I went ahead and kept the product and used it, carefully, till it was gone. But it didn't last as long. I think the air caused some of it to evaporate. When I was out, I ordered the next bottle. It just arrived. I took off the security tape and the same thing happened. I have now wrapped the top with a bit of plastic wrap. But, clearly, they have switched bottle manufacturers and now have a substandard product. Given how expensive it is, beware that you don't lose your serum the first time you go to use it. Update: Re-ordered and new bottle arrived today (see video). Same problem with the cap :o( Seriously, how many more of these defective caps do y'all have?

The scent is also very nice, has a strong citrus, grapefruit and orange overtones. In addition to how great the product is, the seller reached out to me to see how I'm liking their product, and were super helpful with some tips and even were nice enough to send me a free trial of their liquid exfoliant which I am also really enjoying. Super great company, def one to support!

As stated in some of the other reviews, this stuff is pretty harsh. I noticed that it stings my face, but it didn't bother me too much and it made me feel like it was working. :) I am a skincare fanatic and regularly use strong products that contain acids and retinol on my face, but I usually forget to bring them down onto my neck. This product did not have any bad effects on my face, but when I used it on my neck, it burned extremely bad and I was left with raw red patches. You can see it in the pictures I have posted. These pics were taken two days after putting the serum on my neck. That being said, I will probably keep using it on my face since it seems to be able to tolerate it better than my neck. To be safe, I plan to cut back to using it only two or three times a week. I do think this is an effective product, but I would be EXTREMELY cautious using it if your skin is not used to acids and/or retinol. I would also recommend washing it off if the stinging does not go away in about a minute because it is probably actually burning your skin at that point, much like a chemical burn. I would absolutely avoid this product if you have sensitive skin. So just be very careful with this stuff and always research the ingredients you are putting on your body!

avis.texte: I am truly happy with TruSkin. I use my toner, serum and moisturizers in the morning and at night and my skin is so clear! In my photos I have no foundation on and I am not using any photo filter. Highly recommend TruSkin vitamin c super serum, moisturizer and facial toner

Aside from the great smell, this stuff has seemed to really help my skin. I suffer from dry, sensitive skin, so everything irritates it. This line has helped with the texture of my skin and made it much softer. It also doesn’t cause much irritation which scented products usually do.

avis.titre: Cannot figure out how to contact seller
avis.texte: Jar lid was broken. It won’t close and whole top is cracked around it. I’m afraid I can’t send it back because it’ll just leak everywhere and be a mess so.. it’s going to dry out super quick because I cant close it, and I can’t send it back for replacement so that’s not cool. Haven’t been using it long enough for full “real” review of product.
Really like the way it feels so far but the cap came broken and is unable to be closed tightly :(

This is my second purchase of this product. I didn't think it would improve my facial skin so much and in such a short time. I've tried several others, and this is undoubtedly the best serum I know. I recommend that customers try it; they won't regret it.

I was very excited to try this serum from TruSkin, however, when the product arrived, the cap was damaged. The outer packaging and inner plastic seal were both undamaged, but once I removed the plastic seal, I noticed the cap was damaged. Seems like the plastic broke at a fracture point. Regardless, I am pretty bummed!!

I love the actual product, but have had several issues with packaging: twice the dropper has not worked and this last time. The top of the dropper around the lid separated 2 days after receiving it and leaked a good portion of the bottle. Great product. Not great quality of packaging.
Been using for about a year and have noticed a huge difference in my forehead lines. My skin feels a lot tighter.
"It is a very good, excellent product" And it became my daily skin care routine ✨❤️❤️
I seriously disliked the bottle leaking. After my first review I am adding the serum feels grainy. I have used this product before and liked it but c’mon. Quality control

avis.titre: Broken cap on 1st order and reordorder
avis.texte: First one had a broken cap which I didn’t notice until I took off the plastic seal. The replacement product came and I was about to break the seal when I noticed it too has a broken cap. I didn’t bother unsealing as I am returning both products. Too bad I was looking forward to using this product, how can I “shake well” before use if the cap top is broken?

I opened this for the first time and put a few drops in my palm, and when I rubbed my hands together I felt something gritty. A couple seconds later I saw blood and realized that the glass dropper had broken and there were bits of glass in the serum. Thankfully I rubbed my hands before putting this on my face... On closer inspection the dropper broke even more. A shame because I was looking forward to trying this.

Just got it today, opened the box and remove plastic wrap and the lid is broke. Ugh! So I sent this one back and today I received my replacement and guess what the lid is broke on this one too. I’m done with this product. Stinks because I really was interested in having the great results others have experienced.
The bottle cap was broken upon opening for the first time. I’m seeing several other reviews stating this same thing. I’ve never had this issue with any other TruSkin products.

avis.titre: Second time ordered and the lid is broke? What the heck!
avis.texte: Well I like this product and I have a lid with a dropper that fits .. but maybe to look for another serum if this is the normal from this company

avis.titre: Strange color and smell, bad batch?
avis.texte: I bought this in November 2018 and just opened it now. It has a terrible smell and is milky white. Is this normal?? My other vitamin C serums are all clear and no smell. Not putting it on my face, should I throw it out?

avis.titre: Broken top on both bottles and funky smell
avis.texte: Was afraid to use both bottle tops had been cracked open which might have spoiled the contents. Sorry i waited to long to open so i can’t return

This is the second one that I ordered that came like this. As soon as I opened the box and the seal the cap/squeezer was cracked. I thought the first one that I got was going to be like that but nope. The second one was exactly the same way. Returned both bottles. 😟

avis.titre: Maybe not for my skin type?
avis.texte: I am 50 and decided that my skin needed a little help regaining some plump and combating wrinkles. I feel the burn if I accidentally apply too much of the product but see no change in my skin.
The product seems great, however it came damaged and its basically useless to me as I’m assuming ingredients have been ruined.

Bottle cap breaks and leaks Bottle cap near squeeze top breaks and product leaks out. Found empty bottle twice in my cosmetics bag. Cap is defective!! Returned the first one after one day and now have to return second bottle after 2 days. Quality control people!!
Best product I have used so far ...got so many compliments for glowing skin ..love it
Works pretty good. I did see a difference after a week or so. Skin was softer and product absorbed well, nothing crazy though. I wish it came in bigger bottle because it seems to go down fast.
This cap has a defect! I received this in good condition but a few days on the counter the lid cracked in a perfect line on the cap. Did anyone else have this problem? also, this burned my skin.

This is this 2nd replacement. Every time I unravel the plastic seal the top either comes cracked or cracks upon unwrapping. Product cannot be closed to air or it will lose potency otherwise I wouldn’t care.
Disappointing. Top pipette on the bottle arrived broken, greasy with product leaking & exposed to air… I hope to get a replacement. This seems to have happened to others as well.

Just purchased this serum. I turn 40 this month, and I’ve began to hate looking in the mirrors. A very tired girl who works too much, had a very demanding job requiring 10-12 hour days leading to 60+ hours a week. Significant weight loss (100lbs) I have developed wrinkles. I decided it’s time to care for myself, and my face. I do tan 2-3 times a week ( I know I know 🫠) I did lots of research and read tons of reviews. I have a good face wash and moisturizer but figured it’s time to add a toner to aid in my dark age spots and a serum to help my lines. The serum went on wonderfully and I used two small drops and rubbed it in. I took photos after apply my toner and serum and will update at a later time.

avis.titre: Great but this item is overpriced x2
avis.texte: Love it. It's just over priced. Look at the picture. Both items are $24 and the active ingredients are same. One is 2x the size of the other. You be the judge.
I love this product but i don't always buy it because every time i do, the top part of the dropper pops out...on it's own, and i don't know what's going on
Was anticipating using this product but it arrived broken😩😫, therefore can’t give my honest review on this serum but so far am using other products in the line and it’s been good.
I unboxed this product, removed the plastic seal and the cap was cracked. I have not even had a chance to use it. Very disappointed.
Arrived only to find that the dropper lid was split. Unable to mix serum before use. No damage to the box. Big disappointment.
Upon opening the applicator eye dropper just fell apart - I am unable to actually close the cap really cheap packaging
Second delivery and this one is also broken!! I will be sending this back again for a refund!!!
El producto llegó en mal estado todo el producto se perdió en la caja . Perdí el dinero
The dropper is completely broken. When I took off the seal and shook the bottle, it went everywhere.
It broke me up! Bigger acne than l had. Not for my sensitive skin .

I looked in the mirror one day was mortified, it was like wrinkles/loose skin appeared over night, I'm only 43, but my neck looked 73. For days I was obsessed w/ finding a miracle & researched hundreds of products & reviews. I decided on TruSkin C Plus Super Serum & TruSkin Retinol Moisturizer... BEST DECISION EVERRRR! After just 20 days I have my self esteem back! Pics 1 & 2 are the day I started, pics 3 & 4 were taken on day 10 and pics 5 & 6 is day 20! TruSkin accomplished what thousands of dollars for a facelift would've costed me. I took pics so I could see any slight changes for myself, as you can see I had way better than slight results! This isn't a paid review (something I always fear when reading reviews) & you can see it's me in all of the pics thanks to my moles :-/ I just felt like a product that produces results like this needs to be shared w/ everyone that may be as down about their appearance as I was. I massage the serum on my face & neck 3-4 nights a week (& still have 1/2 bottle left!) & use the retinol moisturizer daily. I now plan to use TruSkin products until FOREVERARY! NOTE: I that I take Sanar Collagen capsules as well & while I believe they've helped, I didn't see a dramatic change from them until adding TruSkin to my regimine
Only been using this product about a week, but I swear it’s already cleared up and brightened my skin. Great quality. I use it after the shower and follow with a moisturizer. Worth the money!

This serum has a lot going on. Vitamin C, Niacinamide, retinol, hylauronic acid. If a serum has so many I gradients I wonder about how much if each it really has. This serum notably does not disclose what the % of vitamin C is. I've been using 25% for years and e not want to waste my time and money on something weaker. If you've tried all these ingredients individually and know how they work on your skin and are ok with an unknown amount of C maybe this is worth a try, but I like to have more specifics.

I was really surprised how thick this serum was - more like a thicker viscose texture than a thin Vitamin C Serum. Not horrible, just unexpected, and because of the thickness, better for night than day wear. The scent was pleasant, almost like orange. Unlike other Vitamin C Serums, this one didn't sting my face at all, and absorbed well. It also didn't leave my sensitive skin red like other serums containing niacinamide often do. Overall, a great product to add to my night time skin care routine

TruSkin Vitamin C plus serum has a lot of potential ingredients. In one step you can have all you need in one product including retinol. Since it has retinol and salicylic acid I prefer to use it at night to reduce potential irritation. I like it so far.

First I’d like to say this product really saved my face. I’ve tried products from black soap, aveeno face pads, biore face wash, clean and clear, mederma, proactiv, literally all types of products which varied in price range. Until I found this serum! The proof is in my picture. This serum has stopped all breakouts!! I haven’t had a single bump since I’ve started using this serum and my face is finally clearing!!! I can’t remember the last time I had clear skin! This serum is amazing!!! It is a now must have! Don’t hesitate to buy it, it really works! I have been using this product since March 6 2019 so it’s been a little over a month with amazing results. In a few more months I’m sure my skin will be completely clear!!! Really happy I found this serum.

The consistency is a bit different in this TruSkin Vitamin C-Plus Super Serum than other Vitamin C serums I've used; it a creamy liquid rather than clear. I use at least 7-8 drops to get coverage for my entire face, which is more than the 3-5 drops they say will be needed. If I don't, it dries too quickly, and I can't get to all parts of my face. I do like that the serum dries quickly, though, and there is really no tacky residue whatsoever. When applying, there is a lovely, fresh, citrusy scent that lasts just a short time. As per the label, I've been using this only a few times a week (I guess it's extra strong). My skin is left feeling tight and smooth. I do follow up with a good night cream after.

35 yrs old and am very insecure so I have been looking for something to boost my confidence. My job doesn't really require me to wear lots of makeup (I like to sport a more natural look), and because of this serum I don't even need foundation to feel okay about my skin. Also, the dark spot above my left eyebrow has faded drastically you can hardly see it now!!! It has also helped even out my skin tone and faded the red cystic acne scars I accumulated over the years. I'd especially consider trying this serum if you have thinner, pale skin. Just absolutely amazing results.

I've been using this for about 2 weeks now and I haven't noticed a big difference. I was using another Vitamin C serum so it is not new to my skin, but my previous was not mixed with hyaluronic acid or niacinamide. After each use during the first week my face was turning red and within the hour it would lessen. My previous serum seemed to really brighten my skin and diminish my blemishes to where this is a hit or miss. I wonder given the combined ingredients if it will take a few more weeks for the full effect or maybe my skin is not a fan. Regardless, I will continue to use and update if I feel this has changed.

avis.titre: Super Ingredients with a Citrusy Scent
avis.texte: Top notch ingredients! Love the light citrusy scent. The serum itself is cream-colored as opposed to clear, like most other similar products, making it easier to measure out the exact number of drops you're applying. Skin absorbs it quickly with no greasy feeling, and no irritation whatsoever. Since you're using just a few drops a a day for only a few days per week, this product should last quite a while. (Be sure to follow with a moisturizer, as per directions.) Watch out, lines and wrinkles!

Great serum for brightening your skin from sun damage. I’m in my mid 30s and the sun really took a toll on my face, I have great skin with the exception of these annoying sun spots. I started using the Truskin vitamin C serum first, went through a whole bottle of it. I liked the vitamin C serum but needed something a bit more aggressive. I started using the complex C plus serum and the Truskin moisturizer. I definitely noticed a great improvement within a month. I do use other products since starting my day and night routine and have switched over to using the serum at night. I have noticed a huge difference since starting my day and night routine and I will update everyone after 3 months of continuous use. So far this is my improvement after a months time.

avis.titre: Completely satisfied and my skin proves it!
avis.texte: I'm going on 37 and I love the Sun. Over the past 2 years I have noticed the Crow's feet coming in and A little sun damage. This product is amazing though. I have always worn foundation and about a week after I started this, I have not touched foundation since! My skin is soft and moisture ized and protected all day. There was a comment by peanut about how this product gave her cystic acne. I just wanna point out that that's not possible. Cystic acne actually is not your typical acne. It's in your blood stream. This product nor would any other product cause cystic acne. Now if it doesn't cooperate with your skin it could possibly cause topical acne, but that's it. So please don't be scared by that review. And yes, I'm real lol! Im a mom and a hard worker and I review honestly about every product I try. I love this one and I hope you do as well! My face feels and looks like it did when I was 16!

avis.titre: WARNING! Bleached and damaged my skin!
avis.texte: WARNING!! I used this product for a week or two on my legs and developed white spots (loss of color) all over my legs (even in spots where the product was not applied directly)! I stopped using it as soon as I saw the spots but I am still getting new spots and the spots are growing in size! Please do not buy this, especially if you are a person of color! I am freaking out!

avis.titre: Before and after and the after looks so much worse
avis.texte: I don’t know what’s happening but I’m not liking it!! Instead of improving skin tone it has made my face worse! I didn’t have super bad skin tone. Just a few dark spots and wrinkling. Now my face has dark spots all over and I don’t know how to reverse this! What is going on??!

My skin has changed in my 40’s and this product was recommended by a friend. It made my face break out in a rash. I have tried it several times, and the same thing happens each time. I do not like the texture of it, it feels heavy and oily on my skin. I will not buy anything g like this again, in particular this brand.

So I bought this serum about a year ago. I’ve waited a long time to write this review because I really wanted to give you an idea of what it could accomplish with long-term use. Well, I can tell you, it’s been amazing. Now, I can’t give the serum all the credit. I’ve really improved my skincare routine by becoming more faithful in my cleansing, started drinking more water, improved my diet & started an exercise program. That’s why you’ll notice the reduced acne and weight loss in the photo comparison. But this serum has drastically improved my skin texture, reduced fine lines and plumped my skin. I HAVE NOT HAD ANY BOTOX, INJECTIONS OR FILLERS. So take this review and photo for what it’s worth but I’m here today buying more of it. I alternate between the regular Vitamin C serum in the morning and the Super Serum at night. I use Lancome Rénergie Lift Multi-Action Lifting and Firming day and night creams. I also have a Nuface Trinity that I use a couple times a week and I dermaroll weekly when I do my Sunday night at-home facial (steam, exfoliate & mask). It’s hell getting old!

I am an Esthetician and not easily convinced or persuaded by the huge skin care industry and the plethora of expensive, recommended by celebrity, products on the market. I believe in serums. The good ones reach the layer of the skin that produces the collagen and elastin, the building blocks of younger looking skin. Unfortunately, they are usually very expensive and my clients felt that the more money they paid, the better they would look. I saw TruSkin C Plus serum on Amazon and decided at the price it was worth a try. I always tell my clients...read the labels. TruSkin hit all the points, Vit. C ,Hyaluronic Acid, Niacinamide and Retinol for a great price. I have now ordered my second bottle, put it on my Facebook page and recommended it to friends. Within a week of using it at night before my moisturizer, and in the morning under my day moisturizer, I could see an improvement in my skin. I am 77 years old and my photo is recent.

avis.titre: Trueskin really cares about their customers
avis.texte: *Please read the entire review before making a decision* I have never gotten this type of reaction on my skin. I see there are a lot of great reviews and it seems to work for some people but the reaction on my skin was terrible. I am embarrassed to go out looking this way. Update: 9/14/2022 Trueskin really cares about their customers. After I wrote my review a representative contacted me to find out more about my skin type and concerns. They suggested other products that would best work for me. I also discovered that I did not use the product as directed so this could also have been a reason for my break out. I am seeing a dermatologist this week so hopefully they can prescribe something that will clear the acne soon. I appreciate the concern of the company. They showed they really care about their customers. Once my skin is better I still would love to use their products. They have great reviews and I see the great results on other women. So make sure you use the product as directed which is only 2 - 3 drops 2 - 3 times a week to avoid any bad reactions.

When I read about the product it was for age spots. It says face serum but also for body. My face doesn’t have any spots but I figured with all of the ingredients it should work on my arms. After 4 months I can’t rell much difference. Maybe it would work on the face but I will not buy for my arms.

avis.titre: I purchased this and the Vitamin C-Plus Super Serum in mid Dec
avis.texte: I purchased this and the Vitamin C-Plus Super Serum in mid Dec. I was wondering if this product would actually work since I am a little over 50. I took a picture of my face(like you should do) to keep track of the results. Today I just happened to looked at my finger that I apply the products with because it caught me eye. My finger print on my right hand isn't as deep. If you look up the finger there is no difference. I use these products 3x a week only at night. With a vitamin C serum daily during the day.
It has a lovely scent and so tender to the skin I must say. I’m a first user though I will put more words on how it’s working.
What is going onnnn?? I love this product, but all 3 bottles that I've received have been defective.

Arrived with a broken top. Requested exchange and got a new one - with the same spot broken. Clearly they need to evaluate the design. Not worth the effort of returning again but it’s leaking everywhere so probably won’t use
